claims.claim: Successful PRIMARY runs produce bounded Runtime-owned RUN_OBSERVATION sidecars while canonical ResultPackage structure remains unchanged.
Successful REMEDIATION and REPAIR runs use the same observation semantics without changing existing execution authority.
Post-admission executor and verification failures produce truthful FAILURE observations with available phase timing.
Pre-RUN remediation admission rejection remains outside RUN_OBSERVATION handling.
Observation durations use controlled monotonic elapsed-time measurements with finite non-negative validation.
Success and failure transports preserve optional byte-exact observation sidecars while remaining compatible with historical refs that lack them.
Observation persistence and transport failures remain subordinate to original RESULT or FAILURE authority and do not trigger another executor invocation.
RUN_OBSERVATION remains structurally separate from canonical ResultPackage, RESULT/EVIDENCE validation, review authority, and direct candidate acceptance.
Optional trusted token usage is strictly validated, while absent or malformed usage is omitted without changing execution truth.
README documents observation timing boundaries, terminal semantics, human-wait distinctions, and the absence of automatic scoring or routing.
